sara (PM): Quick sync: ACME asked for a clear pilot contract for eval-triggered alerts + quant recs. Main asks: tenant opt-in, webhook scorecards, and audit trail.

kai (Eng): Suggest we define a "signal contract" (what we send customers) and a storage SLO for per-tenant evals. Canary = internal + 1 alpha tenant.

anika (ML): Proposed signals: concordance_p95, hallucination_rate_top10, latency_p99. Regression detection = relative change vs 7d baseline; default threshold = 5%.

miguel (CS): They want a weekly scorecard and an immediate hard-stop webhook when a critical prompt drops >5%. HMAC signature + audit-id required.

lina (Design): UX: alert card with: signal name, delta, recommended quant profile, expected quality delta, expected cost delta. Small CTA: "Propose" and "Apply (audit)". Keep the card compact.

vera (Legal): Need consent text and data retention limits. Must include opt-in checkbox and ability to revoke. Also confirm minimal fields in webhook payload to avoid PII.

kai (Eng): Minimal webhook payload (example):
```
{"audit_id":"uuid","tenant":"acme","signal":"concordance_p95","baseline":0.89,"current":0.82,"delta":-0.07}
```
We'll sign with HMAC and rate-limit deliveries.

anika (ML): For quant recs: run a sim with candidate profiles, surface cost and latency deltas plus measured quality delta. Recommend when quality_delta < 1% and overall score <= 2.0 (tunables).

sara (PM): Draft pilot acceptance gates: 1) pilot with internal + 2 alphas, 2) alert precision >= 75% on top-50 prompts, 3) quant recs accuracy: when applied, quality delta <1% in 85% of cases, 4) median TTD <= 7 days. Pilot length = 6 weeks.

kai (Eng): Risks: storage (~50-150GB/mo per 100 tenants), burst alerting -> pager storms. Mitigate: compressed deltas, full traces 30d, webhook backoff, paging SLOs.

miguel (CS): CS actions: recruit 2 alphas (ACME + 1), collect consent, provide webhook endpoints for testing. Also request admin contact and preferred escalation path.

anika (ML): ML actions: publish signal contract, run backtests on 6 customers, produce weight tuning suggestions.

lina (Design): I'll share a prototype card + modal with the CTA flows by EOD.

ops-bot: Feature flag created: ff/eval-alerts-signal-contract on branch feat/eval-alerts. Staging provisioned. CI queued. :rocket:

sara (PM): I'll roll this into a 1-pager PRD and add owners + timelines. Please drop weekly status updates in this thread. If anyone objects to the gates, call it out now. :thumbsup:
